Students typically have strict capital limits ($8,000–$16,000 upfront), prioritize insurance costs, and require low routine maintenance.

Level 1 charging (120V) provides 3–5 miles of range per hour. Level 2 (240V) provides 25–35 miles/hr. Apartment-dwelling students without dedicated parking rely heavily on campus or municipal public chargers.
Modern liquid-cooled lithium-ion batteries degrade at approximately 1.5%–2.3% capacity per year. Used EVs should have battery state-of-health (SoH) diagnostics verified prior to purchase.
US Section 25E provides up to 30% or $4,000 federal tax credit for eligible used clean vehicles purchased from licensed dealers under $25,000, subject to income thresholds.
